name: @mercatus-liber/internal-bi
description: Owned, internal business-intelligence layer -- revenue over time, order volume, top products, conversion funnel, promotion redemption rates, and (contract-only) inventory turns -- architected as an explicit, swappable BiMetricsAdapter contract (subsystem 20). Depends on @mercatus-liber/core only; reads orders/skus/promotions via narrow structural interfaces, never importing @mercatus-liber/checkout-orders, @mercatus-liber/catalog, or @mercatus-liber/promotions directly. The conversion funnel is backed by its own small, in-memory, going-forward-only event log, populated by subscribing to a fixed allow-list of existing bus events -- never a direct call into any other subsystem.
